2 substitution.capability: Explicit provider substitution for unstarted milestones as an amendment revision authorized by every affected party (old and new providers); awarded work immutable; parent obligations untouched

3 route planning.capability: Shared communication-route planning across relay offers: bounded hop enumeration, deterministic ranking, exposure re-derived independently from the offers, then the planned route carried by the relay service
